subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A phone update showed users how many hours they spent on each app.”?
options: Students began checking the station to see how much rain had fallen.
It played a short piece of music instead of a sharp ringing sound.
A letter from the past can show people how much they have changed.
Jason was shocked to see how much time he spent watching short videos.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students began checking the station to see how much rain had fallen.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It played a short piece of music instead of a sharp ringing sound.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A letter from the past can show people how much they have changed.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Jason was shocked to see how much time he spent watching short videos.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Jason was shocked to see how much time he spent watching short videos.」，答案為「Jason was shocked to see how much time he spent watching short videos.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Jason was shocked to see how much time he spent watching short videos.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
